responsibilities: Implement axial hexagonal math utilities for pointy-topped and flat-topped hex grids.
Design and write zero-allocation HexTilemap components using flat Int32List data representations.
Implement a HexTilemapRenderSystem using Canvas.drawRawAtlas with pre-allocated Float32List buffers for optimal performance.
constraints: Must strictly adhere to zero per-frame allocation rules.
All hex grid operations must use unboxed primitive values and avoid instantiating Vector2 or coordinate objects.
Must ensure full test coverage for all hexagonal math, coordinates, and rendering calculations.
context: Focuses on providing coordinate conversions, distance calculations, neighbors, grid layouts, and batched hex tile rendering within the engine.
